subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Ethically good behaviour one has
solution:
The correct answer is: **Virtue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Virtue **means morally good behaviour or character. (सदाचार)
 
• It is the most appropriate word for the given group of words as it directly relates to ethically good behaviour.
 
• The word is a noun and is often used to describe someone's personal qualities or traits.
